title: Release lifecycle policy
description: Action and state contract for the release lifecycle. The lifecycle has exactly nine states. Six are persisted by the six mutating actions, one state per action. Three are derived and never persisted: planned from a deterministic plan receipt, offline_verified from a passing deterministic offline-verification receipt, and published from a signed publication receipt verified by an observation. Each action declares exactly one effect ceiling, the single role that may initiate it, the prior states it consumes, the read receipts it must bind, and the state it appends. Read actions are pure: they emit a deterministic receipt or observation to stdout and persist no repository state. Remote-write actions require an exact, one-time, Owner-issued effect authorization. Evidence publication and product publication are distinct actions and neither implies the other. release publish appends publication_dispatched and never published.

receipt_schemas.description: The four contracts a receipt or observation is validated against. A document that does not validate against its declared contract is not a receipt.

states.description: The ordered lifecycle. Each state declares whether it is persisted as an appended record or derived from a receipt, and the exact predecessor it requires.

read_action_purity.description: The three read actions write nothing. They emit a deterministic document to stdout and leave the repository byte-identical.

deterministic.description: Identical bound inputs produce identical bytes. A read that varies with wall-clock time or host state is not a receipt.

shared_authorization.description: One authorization never covers both publications. Each remote effect consumes its own exact authorization.

publication_dispatch.description: Publication is a two-party fact. The repository records that it dispatched; only a signed receipt from the protected external workflow lets an observation report that the publication happened.

terminal_state_appendable.description: No action appends published. A state record naming it is rejected by the state contract.

receipt_binds_identity.description: published is derived only by verifying the receipt against the exact recorded publication_dispatched state, candidate, artifact, and trust identity. Any divergence derives nothing.

observation_kernel.description: The frozen procedure by which an observation may derive published, and the exact codes by which it refuses. Deriving published is a cross-check between three documents that must agree completely: the recorded head, the observation's own claim about what it verified against, and the signed receipt. Any single divergence derives no published; there is no partial derivation and no near match.

kernel_id.description: Every emitted observation carries this identifier. An observation carrying another one was produced by a procedure this policy does not define.

receipt_canonicalization_kernel_id.description: Receipt digests are recomputed under the receipt's own frozen canonicalization kernel rather than trusted as printed.

mismatch_behavior.description: A mismatch is not a failure to publish and not a weaker published. It is the absence of a derivation, and the lifecycle stays at publication_dispatched.

persisted_state.description: The only states an appended lifecycle state record may name.

persisted.description: True when the state exists as an appended record. False when it is derived from a receipt and exists only in the emitted document.

appendable.description: True when a lifecycle state record may name this state.

requires_state.description: The exact predecessor this state requires. Null only for the first state and for the state that opens the persisted chain.

requires_prior_state.description: Empty means the action opens the persisted chain or reads without a required predecessor. Only persisted states are consumable as a predecessor.

requires_receipts.description: The read receipts this action must bind before it may act. A receipt is checkable evidence, never an authorization.

produces_state.description: The single state this action appends. No action produces planned, offline_verified, or published.

emits_receipt.description: The deterministic document a read action emits to stdout. Null for every mutating action.

observational.description: True when the action reports state and changes none. An observational action never advances, repairs, or revives a lifecycle.

binds_identity.description: The identity classes the action must bind exactly before it may report or act.

produces_state.description: A dispatch is not an outcome. release publish never produces published.
